Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

Commercial & Supplier Management

• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Join Traxial (A Magnax Company) as a Mechanical Design Engineer – Robotics and help shape compact, high-performance actuators. You'll translate demanding motion requirements into manufacturable mechanical designs.
 
 

• Design mechanical solutions for robotic systems, from concept to production. 

• Create 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying industry standards and GD&T. 

• Perform mechanical calculations and design verification for performance, reliability, and durability. 

• Work with suppliers and subcontractors on components, processes, tolerances, materials, and specs. 

• Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and design improvement. 
 

• Master's in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 

• 3+ years designing robotic systems, actuators, or precision motion systems. 

• Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools. 

• Able to translate payload, speed, torque, force, power, accuracy, and duty cycle into mechanical design requirements. 

• Strong awareness of emerging trends in robotics, actuation, and motion technologies. 

• Existing work authorization in Belgium required. 

• Team player, creative, can-do mindset, fluent English.

“ 
We make it possible” is not just a slogan, it is our mission. Our growth is driven by our expertise and commitment, within an organization that values diversity and equal opportunities.
 

As part of the development of our activities in Belgium and the Netherlands, we are looking for an Administrative and Finance Officer to strengthen our administrative and financial team. You will work closely with the Director of Administration & Development in Belgium and actively contribute to financial monitoring and performance analysis, supporting both local teams and management in Belgium and France.
 

We invest in your professional development and in recognizing your financial expertise. Together, we are building a future of innovation, reliability, and team spirit.
 

Profile:
 

As an Administrative and Finance Officer, you provide essential administrative support to the Director and ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the company’s administration.
 

In this versatile and hands-on role, you will be responsible for various aspects of the company’s administration. You ensure that information is accurate, documents are up to date and files are properly followed up. You enjoy bringing order and structure to information and quickly identifying errors or missing elements.
 

You are meticulous, flexible and motivated to contribute to the development of a fast-growing company.
 

Your responsibilities :
 
 

• Manage and follow up on the company’s general administration 

• Check, process and follow up on invoices and payments 

• Monitor and update financial data and cost centres 

• Prepare and update various reports and tracking tools 

• Check, structure and maintain Excel files and other administrative documents 

• Organise and improve existing administrative data and tools 

• Provide administrative support for commercial activities and sales 

• Provide administrative support to the Director in the development of the company and on various projects 

• Prepare, collect and structure the information required by the Director 

• Follow up on various administrative actions and ensure deadlines are met  

In our small company with a straightforward organisational structure, this role is deliberately broad and varied. You are a trusted person who ensures that the company’s administration is well organised and who actively contributes to structuring and improving its day-to-day operations.

What you bring :
 
 

• Degree in accounting, business administration, management or a similar field 

• Excellent command of French, Dutch and English, both written and spoken 

• Good knowledge of Excel and an interest in analysing financial data 

• Analytical mindset, strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills 

• Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with management

jobs.occupation: Power Electronics and Motor Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we are designing the next generation of high-performance, energy-efficient systems. We’re looking for a PE & Motor Control Engineer to join our innovative team and play a pivotal role in creating systems that push boundaries in robotics and industry.
 

This is what you’ll do: 
 
 

•  

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and optimize high-efficiency power electronic & motor control systems. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed requirements and functional designs for power electronic circuits & motor controllers.. 
   
 

•  

Perform simulations, testing, and validation to ensure system performance meets all requirements. 
   
 

•  

Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the design, prototyping, and manufacturing phases. 
   
 

•  

Ensure products are compliant with relevant standards for power drive systems. 
   
 

•  

Stay informed about the latest trends and developments in power electronics in robotics & industrial applications. 
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Minimum of 3 years of experience in power electronics & circuit design.
   
 

•  

Strong knowledge of inverters and motor controllers.
   
 

•  

Experience with PCB design tools such as Kicad, Altium or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Experience with electronic circuit simulation software such as LTSpice or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Understanding of thermal management and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC).
   
 

•  

Previous experience in model-based design and/or FPGA platforms will be considered a plus.
   
 

•  

A team player with excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
   
 

•  

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

jobs.description:
Your Role

As a Production Operator Coatings, you are hands-on in the entire coatings production process. You ensure every batch is produced accurately and safely, from raw material to finished product.

What You Will Do

• Prepare raw materials and equipment

• Accurately weigh and add ingredients following recipes

• Operate and monitor mixing installations

• Closely follow mixing parameters (temperature, timing, method)

• Take samples and assist with quality controls

• Register production and quality data accurately

• Fill finished coatings into packaging and check weights

• Label and palletize finished products

• Keep machines and workstations clean and safe

• Report issues or deviations promptly

• Support your colleagues and be flexible within production

A Typical Day

You start the day by preparing materials and checking your workstation. Throughout the day, you follow set procedures for mixing and quality control, keep accurate records, and communicate any issues to your team leader. You end your shift with a tidy workplace and clear handover for the next day.

Ready to grow with us?

If you are looking for a varied, responsible role in production and want to be part of an ambitious team, we encourage you to apply!

• Minimum a few years of experience in a production environment (mixing, weighing, quality control)

• Experience with paint, coatings, chemical products, or mixing is a strong advantage

• Physically able to regularly lift weights up to 25kg

• B driving license required; willing to occasionally drive to Brussels

• Forklift experience for handling heavy pallets

• Very good command of English; understanding of Dutch is an asset

• Flexible, all-round team player

• Motivated for a long-term collaboration

• You work accurately, are well-organized, and have an eye for detail

• You are physically capable of lifting heavier objects

As a Senior Information Security Officer, you are the strategic leader who defines, drives and strengthens Luminus’ cybersecurity vision across the entire organization. You ensure that our IT, OT, business operations, subsidiaries and affiliates are protected against evolving cyber threats while supporting our mission to deliver reliable and secure energy services to millions of customers.

What you'll do

• You define and implement a company-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with Luminus’ business objectives, risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
• Identify, assess, prioritize and report cybersecurity risks to executive leadership and governance bodies, while ensuring compliance with regulations such as NIS, GDPR and other applicable cybersecurity frameworks.
• You develop and maintain security policies, standards and governance frameworks, and ensure their effective adoption across the organization, subsidiaries and affiliates.
• Build and manage the cybersecurity roadmap, driving initiatives that strengthen resilience, compliance and operational efficiency while building on the strong foundations already in place.
• You work closely with IT, OT, business leaders, the Data Protection Officer, security operations teams and the Information Security Forum to integrate security into key activities and create alignment across the organization.
• Represent Luminus towards regulators, authorities, auditors and external partners, while chairing the Information Security Forum and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

What you'll bring

• You have at least 8 years of experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role.
• Extensive expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, security technologies, regulatory compliance and the ability to translate security requirements into business value.
• You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can clearly explain security risks, priorities and recommendations to senior management, directors and subsidiary leaders.
• Strong influencing, organizational and prioritization skills, allowing you to build consensus, challenge stakeholders when needed and drive security improvements across a complex organization.
• You hold a relevant master's degree or have acquired equivalent expertise through professional experience.
• Recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM and ISO 27001 Lead Implementer are required. A good understanding of IT and OT environments, risk management and the energy sector is a strong asset. Fluent English and French are required.

Are you passionate about building secure cloud environments and embedding security into every stage of software delivery? In this role, you will help shape a security-first culture by integrating security into development processes, strengthening cloud environments, and enabling teams to deliver resilient applications at scale.

What you'll do

• You design, build and maintain automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring security is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle.
• Working closely with development, cloud and operations teams, you help implement security-by-design practices across AWS and Azure environments.
• You assess cloud security posture, identify risks and lead remediation efforts to improve compliance with security frameworks and benchmarks.
• You support the security of containerized platforms and infrastructure-as-code solutions by promoting secure configurations and automation.
• You provide expertise on secure coding standards, DevSecOps tooling and application security practices, helping teams strengthen their security maturity.
• By monitoring key security indicators and supporting incident investigations, you contribute to the continuous improvement of Luminus' cyber resilience.
 

What you bring

• Proven experience in DevSecOps, cloud security or application security, with a strong understanding of CI/CD environments and security automation.
• Experience working with security technologies such as SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets management solutions, Terraform and software supply chain security practices.
• Strong knowledge of cloud and container technologies, including AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and related security concepts.
• Your understanding of application security principles, OWASP guidelines and vulnerability management enables you to identify and address security risks effectively.
• A collaborative mindset that allows you to work effectively with developers, cloud experts, project teams and external partners.
• Professional proficiency in English and fluency in Dutch and/or French.
